observed_problem: UAOS already declared proactive material-change failure/recovery scenario checks in DOMAIN_HEALTH_ESCALATION_POLICY, but executable domain_health assessment did not implement SCENARIO_OR_RECOVERY_GAP and material architecture admission did not mechanically require a counterfactual FAILURE_AND_RECOVERY scenario before promotion. This left a gap where policy language could remain proactive while execution still depended too heavily on post-failure discovery.

competing_hypotheses.reason: Mature safety/security engineering supports pre-failure scenario analysis and design-time threat/hazard modeling; UAOS already had policy hooks for proactive discovery.
The gap was executable admission, not missing organizational topology. A second controller would duplicate cognition/governance and increase cost.
The repository already defined proactive scenario checks and health-audit activation, but the corresponding runtime/kernel checks were absent.

selected_changes: Material control-plane or Agent-experience architecture changes must include at least one counterfactual FAILURE_AND_RECOVERY scenario before promotion.
ArchitectureExperienceReceipt records admitted failure/recovery scenario IDs.
DomainObservation can declare a pending material change and owner-native failure/recovery scenario evidence.
assess_domain_health now emits HIGH SCENARIO_OR_RECOVERY_GAP before execution when material change evidence is missing.
Regression tests cover both pre-change blocking and admitted preventive evidence.
external_method_evidence: MIT STPA explicitly analyzes potential hazards and future loss scenarios proactively before accidents.
OWASP threat modeling recommends design-time modeling of what can go wrong and continuous refinement before incidents.
assurance_boundary: This prevents a class of avoidable pre-release failures by requiring modeled failure/recovery evidence before material changes. It cannot enumerate every unknown unknown or guarantee zero future incidents. Residual unknowns still require outside-in discovery, adversarial/replay testing, live observation and post-incident learning when genuinely novel failures occur.
post_promotion_observation: Watch whether teams produce meaningful counterfactual scenarios rather than ceremonial text.
Watch false-positive rate of SCENARIO_OR_RECOVERY_GAP for material changes.
Expand scenario diversity only when evidence shows one FAILURE_AND_RECOVERY scenario is insufficient; do not preemptively create a new controller or large SOP.
